column1: # ArcAngel card profiles, read by install.sh. One line per card, tab separated.
# id      the --card name
# chip    AOT compile target (bmg_g21 or bmg_g31)
# vram    memory on the card, GiB
# quant   Unsloth UD quant of Inkling 2 Mini downloaded for this card (unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF)
# kv      K/V cache bits (8 or 4)
# ctx     context length in tokens
# status  tested: run on this card; untested: chosen from the card's memory, not run on one yet
# match   regular expression matched against `lspci` to detect the card
# name    shown in the menu
# How the numbers were picked: weights + K/V cache + ~0.45 GiB of prompt buffers + 0.5 GiB safety margin +
# ~1 GiB for a desktop on the same card must fit. K/V per token of context: ~9 KiB at 4 bits, ~17 KiB at 8.
# Quants: Q4_K_XL and Q8_K_XL share the same NVFP4 experts (40 of 48 expert tensors); Q8_K_XL only widens
# the dense layers to BF16, so it costs a lot of bandwidth for very little quality: no card defaults to it.
# Q3_K_XL, IQ3_XXS and IQ4_XS use weight formats the engine does not support yet (Q3_K, IQ3_S, IQ4_NL, Q5_0).
#id
